description: Plan Director del Agua potable de Riells i Viabrea - Enero 2014 is a dataset listed in IDEE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by riellsiviabrea.cat. The Master Plan is a figure of urban planning in coherence with territorial planning, in this case, of Riells i Viabrea drinking water. Coverage: ES. The portal shows the English title as "Drinking Water Master Plan of Riells i Viabrea - January 2014" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Riells i Viabrea, Pla Director, Agua potable, Master Plan, Aigua potable, Drinkable water. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-idee.
